title: SKE Crystal Juicy Peach Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Juicy Peach flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid captures the rich essence of a freshly picked peach, bursting with natural sweetness. This e-liquid offers a refreshing and uplifting peach taste, making every puff a delightful summery treat. With its 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimized for mouth-to-lung vaping, providing a satisfying balance of flavour and vapour production. The addition of nicotine salts ensures a smoother inhalation than traditional nicotine, making it perfect for those new to vaping or for ex-smokers seeking a gentle yet flavourful option. If you're a fan of fruit flavours, Juicy Peach is a must-try. It's part of SKE Crystal Nic Salts' extensive range that includes various fruit and candy flavours, each providing a unique vaping experience. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
